Palm Springs, California · coffee

Coffee in Palm Springs for cyclists

Where riders in Palm Springs start the day and finish the ride.

Coffee in Palm Springs for cyclists, listed

  1. Starbucks, Highway 74 and El Paseo

    • A group ride starts here
    • 73030 El Paseo, Palm Desert, CA 92260

    The ride from here: Desert Bicycle Club Sunday Climbers (Sundays, 7:30 am) →

    Directions
    More about Starbucks, Highway 74 and El Paseo

    Zone 3, Palm Desert, where Highway 74 meets El Paseo, and the start of the Desert Bicycle Club’s Sunday Climbers (Sundays, 7:30 am): up Highway 74 at your own pace and back down, regrouping at the Art Smith Trailhead (mile 4) and the Vista Point, per the club. A chain store with a patio; it’s here because the climb leaves from it. Two listings give different hours and neither is the store’s own, so check; both have it open before the ride.

  2. The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, El Paseo

    Zone 2, Palm Desert, at El Paseo and San Pablo: the valley’s weekday ride-out.

    • A group ride starts here
    • 73400 El Paseo Dr, Palm Desert, CA 92260
    • 5:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday to Friday; 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. Saturday and Sunday
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, El Paseo

    The Desert Bicycle Club’s weekday A and B rides leave from here in winter (club calendar, Oct 2026; they aren’t in the directory yet, so check the club’s calendar for the day and time), and the store is open before they roll: 5:30 a.m. on weekdays, 6 on weekends, per the chain’s store page. A chain. Nothing on bike parking.

  3. Koffi Rancho Mirage 111 Café

    • A group ride starts here
    • 71-380 Highway 111, Rancho Mirage, CA 92270
    • 6:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. daily

    The ride from here: Desert Bicycle Club Palm Springs Ride (Mondays, 7:30 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Koffi Rancho Mirage 111 Café

    Zone 2, Rancho Mirage, the coffee at the turnaround of the Desert Bicycle Club’s winter ride to Palm Springs (Mondays, 7:30 am): the club’s own page names Koffi in Rancho Mirage as the destination. Koffi is the valley’s own roaster, and the roastery is here, on Highway 111 three blocks west of The River. Open 6:30 to 5:30 every day. Nothing on its page about bike parking.

  4. Koffi Palm Springs Central

    Zone 1, downtown: the early coffee on the morning of the Tour de Palm Springs.

    • 650 E Tahquitz Canyon Way, Palm Springs, CA 92262
    • 6:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. daily
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Koffi Palm Springs Central

    Open at 6:30 every day, on Tahquitz Canyon Way, the cross street of the Tour’s start on South Palm Canyon; the century rolls at 6:30. Koffi has five cafés in the valley and this one is the bakery for all of them, in Kaptur Plaza near the Convention Center, with an outdoor patio facing the San Jacintos. Koffi South (1700 S Camino Real, next to the Ace Hotel) keeps the same hours for the south end of town. Nothing on its page about bike parking.

  5. Townie Bagels

    Zone 1, the Sunny Dunes neighborhood east of downtown: breakfast after the ride in Palm Springs.

    • 650 E Sunny Dunes Rd, Palm Springs, CA 92264
    • 6:30 a.m. to noon; closed Tuesday
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Townie Bagels

    Water-boiled bagels, breakfast sandwiches and cold brew. Open 6:30 a.m. to noon, closed Tuesday (its own page), so it’s early enough for a ride-out and gone by lunch. Taqueria Tlaquepaque’s second store is in the same plaza. Nothing on its page about bike parking.

  6. Main Street Coffee, Old Town La Quinta

    • 78100 Main St, Suite 102, La Quinta, CA 92253
    • 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Main Street Coffee, Old Town La Quinta

    Zone 2, the east-valley stop: Tri-A-Bike’s 20-mile ride from the shop ends at the coffee in Old Town La Quinta, about 0.6 mile from the north end of the Bear Creek Trail (the shop’s rides page). The shop names Old Town Coffee at this address; the center’s own page now lists Main Street Coffee there, open 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily. Nothing on bike parking.

Checked October 4, 2026. No paid placements. Businesses open and close; call before you count on anyone.
